sentences.en: I would rather leave early than travel on rush-hour trains.
sentences.zh: 我宁愿早点离开也不愿在高峰时段坐火车。

sentences.en: The old lady has been rather feeble since her illness.
sentences.zh: 自从生病后，这位老太太身体一直很虚弱。

sentences.en: I'd rather go for a walk than see the movie.
sentences.zh: 与其看电影，我倒不如去散散步。

senses.zh: 颇，相当；而不是；更确切地说
